draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 135th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 10th of 20 at RB. He went 134th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Michael Bush. Testing standouts: bench press (94th percentile). Testing concerns: vertical jump (20th percentile), broad jump (13th percentile). College production: 984 rushing yards in 2023, 11th of 20 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 21 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 running back who played: 93 scrimmage yards against a median of 422, below the norm.
